entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I need to start a return for my VeloBand.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your account, could I get your name and order number?
The name is Sam Jones. Order number is VF789012. Look, I'm in a hurry. I got it about 30 days ago. Can I return it, yes or no?

I understand, Mr. Jones. I've got your order right here. Just so I can properly document this for you, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's just not what I wanted. The whole interface is hard to use. I read the user manual front to back, but it's still confusing. Frankly, I expected more for what it cost. So, can I return it?
I see. Thank you for that information. Let me just quickly check our return policy for you... one moment.
Alright, I've confirmed it. You received the item 30 days ago, and our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. So yes, you are well within the timeframe for a full refund.
Great. Finally. So you'll send me a shipping label?

Yes, absolutely. I'm processing that for you right now. The prepaid return label will be in your email inbox within the next 5 minutes. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed to your original payment method.
Okay. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Mr. Jones?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
